title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24
lineage: MSR > C > DAT > CD > EAC > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 Avalon show highlighted by an epic New Potato Caboose and a mesmerizing Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio that lets the band’s fire shine through, especially on the legendary New Potato Caboose and the long Dark Star. While a few listeners note a rough start to the mix and the power‑cut ending of Lovelight, the overall performance is praised for its soaring improvisations and relentless 1969 energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising standout performances and generally good sound quality; a few note mix issues, yielding an overall strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Instruments and vocals are clear and well‑placed; some reviewers mention early‑mix roughness or typical 16‑track artifacts, but overall the SBD is solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a powerful New Potato after The Other One, a lengthy Cosmic Ether segue, and an adventurous Dark Star; the set ends abruptly due to a power cut during Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is praised for amazing jams and symphonic phrasing, especially on New Potato Caboose and throughout Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh delivers thunderous, extended solos on New Potato Caboose; his lead after verses is highlighted as spectacular.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart and Bill Kreutzmann keep the music moving during the Lovelight power‑cut, adding extra drive to the performance.
